thought.text: I'll delete the contents of the half-initialized cluster so that the entrypoint will re-run the initialization with the corrected script:

reasoning_content: The data directory contains a partially initialized cluster. I need to delete the contents of postgres/data so that the entrypoint will re-initialize with the corrected init.sh. Since this is a new/development data directory containing no user data, it's safe to delete.
